title: The bank statement of a bank account: a three-step import of a file of rows and a screen that matches a row to the journals of the bank account without posting or changing anything; this application has no statement import and no matching

statement_tab.note: The bank statement tab with its import wizard (options, field mapping, result), the imported rows with the status not matched and a match button, and the reconciliation screen with the statement rows against the journals of the bank account not yet matched

no_journal.note: Import, match, unmatch and deleting a row created no journal: the next journal took the number right after the last one

cases.reason: There is no statement import, no statement row and no matching (WP29; the design there is that matching never edits a journal and an import is checksummed and idempotent).

reference.match_rule: the amount of the row equals the amount of the journals chosen
reference.refusal_message: قيمة العملية البنكية يجب أن تكون مساوية لقيمة عمليات النظام
